literal: obstructed · hindered · hard · to carry out
natural: blocked and hard to put into effect

meaning.en: To be so obstructed that a plan or measure cannot be carried out.
meaning.zh: 遇到阻碍，很难进行或实行。

examples.zh: 这项规定过于繁琐，实施起来窒碍难行。
examples.en: The rule is so cumbersome that it is hard to put into effect.

examples.zh: 方案虽好，但资金不足，窒碍难行。
examples.en: The plan is good, but without funds it cannot proceed.

examples.zh: 许多条款与现实脱节，以致窒碍难行。
examples.en: Many clauses are out of touch with reality, and so can hardly be applied.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, in official and written contexts. 窒 (zhì) means 'blocked'.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，多见于公文。“窒”读zhì，意为阻塞。

natural: moral character and writings

meaning.en: A person's moral integrity and scholarly or literary attainment, praised together.
meaning.zh: 指人的品德修养和学问文采，常用来称赞学者的人品与著作。

examples.zh: 这位老先生道德文章，为世人所敬仰。
examples.en: The old scholar's character and writings are admired by all.

examples.zh: 他的道德文章堪称一代楷模。
examples.en: His moral character and works make him a model for a generation.

examples.zh: 追悼会上，众人称颂他的道德文章。
examples.en: At the memorial service people praised his integrity and his writing.

usage.en: Noun, usually used in praise of a respected scholar or writer.
usage.zh: 名词，多用于称赞德高望重的学者、作家。

natural: climb higher with every step

meaning.en: To rise higher and higher, in one's career or fortunes, step by step.
meaning.zh: 一步一步向上，多用来祝愿事业、地位不断提升。

examples.zh: 祝你新的一年步步登高，万事如意。
examples.en: May the new year bring you ever-rising success and all you wish for.

examples.zh: 他在公司一路步步登高，如今已是总监。
examples.en: He has risen step by step at the firm and is now a director.

examples.zh: 重阳节登高，寓意步步登高。
examples.en: Climbing a hill on the Double Ninth carries the wish to rise ever higher.

usage.en: Predicate or greeting; auspicious wish, a close cousin of 步步高升 and 节节高升. Also a pun for 'rise with every step' on festivals like the Double Ninth.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或祝福语，与“步步高升”“节节高升”相近；重阳登高时也取此寓意。

pinyin: xīn yǒu líng xī yī diǎn tōng
literal: heart · has · spirit · rhino horn · one · point · connects
natural: hearts with a touch of the rhino's spirit are linked at a point

meaning.en: Two people's hearts understand each other instantly, without needing words.
meaning.zh: 彼此心意相通，不用多说就能互相了解。

examples.zh: 他们俩默契十足，真是心有灵犀一点通。
examples.en: The two work together so well, truly of one mind.

examples.zh: 不必明说，心有灵犀一点通，我知道你想什么。
examples.en: No need to say it out loud; our hearts are in tune, and I know what you're thinking.

examples.zh: 老搭档之间心有灵犀一点通，一个眼神就够了。
examples.en: Old partners understand each other without words; a glance is enough.

story.en: Li Shangyin's love poem says: 'I have no bright phoenix's wings to fly beside you, but our hearts, like the rhino horn, are linked at a point' (身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通).
story.zh: 唐·李商隐《无题》：“身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通。”

usage.en: Independent line, often shortened to 心有灵犀. Used of lovers, friends and teammates. In legend a rhino's horn has a white thread running through it that links its two ends.
usage.zh: 多作独立语句，常缩略为“心有灵犀”，可用于恋人、朋友、搭档。传说犀牛角中有一条白线贯通两端。

natural: all twisted and crooked

meaning.en: Twisted and crooked; not straight or neat.
meaning.zh: 歪歪扭扭、不整齐、不端正的样子。

examples.zh: 他写的字七扭八歪，像一群蚯蚓。
examples.en: His handwriting wobbles all over the page like a swarm of worms.

examples.zh: 篱笆扎得七扭八歪，一推就倒。
examples.en: The fence is put up crookedly and falls over at a push.

examples.zh: 小孩把被子叠得七扭八歪。
examples.en: The child folded the quilt in a crooked heap.

usage.en: Adjectival or complement; colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，口语。

literal: so as to · cut off · later · trouble
natural: to cut off trouble for good

meaning.en: To take firm action now so that no trouble arises later.
meaning.zh: 采取措施彻底消除以后可能出现的祸患。

equivalents: to nip it in the bud

examples.zh: 必须从根本上整治，以绝后患。
examples.en: It must be put right at the root, to prevent trouble later.

examples.zh: 为杜绝后患，工厂更换了所有老化的管道。
examples.en: To rule out future trouble, the factory replaced all its ageing pipes.

examples.zh: 他当机立断，把隐患清除干净，以绝后患。
examples.en: He acted decisively and cleared the hidden risk away for good.

usage.en: Usually a purpose clause after a verb phrase; formal.
usage.zh: 多作目的状语，位于动词短语之后，书面语。

natural: what evening is this tonight

meaning.en: What a night this is; an exclamation at a rare, happy occasion or reunion.
meaning.zh: 今晚是什么样的夜晚啊，表示对难得相聚或喜庆时刻的感叹；也常感叹时光流转。

equivalents: what a time to be alive

examples.zh: 多年老友终于重聚，今夕何夕，大家都激动不已。
examples.en: The old friends were finally reunited, and everyone was moved to think what a night it was.

examples.zh: 烟花满天，今夕何夕，竟如梦境一般。
examples.en: Fireworks filled the sky, and what a night it was, like something from a dream.

examples.zh: 面对这场盛会，他不禁感叹今夕何夕。
examples.en: Facing the grand gathering, he could not help exclaiming what an evening it was.

story.en: A newly wed couple exclaim: 'What evening is this, that I see this good man?' (今夕何夕，见此良人).
story.zh: 《诗经·唐风·绸缪》：“绸缪束薪，三星在天。今夕何夕，见此良人。”

usage.en: Independent exclamation, literary. Often read as a joyful cry; later poets also used 今夕何夕 for a dazed sense of time (see Su Shi's 'I wonder what year it is tonight').
usage.zh: 多作独立感叹语，书面语。多表欣喜，后世诗词也借以表达时光恍惚之感。

natural: fate not yet settled

meaning.en: Something whose outcome is still undecided and hard to predict.
meaning.zh: 指事情的结局还没有确定，前途未卜。

examples.zh: 这场比赛胜负仍是未定之天。
examples.en: The result of this match is still undecided.

examples.zh: 政策能否落地，目前还是未定之天。
examples.en: Whether the policy will take effect is still up in the air.

examples.zh: 他的去留尚是未定之天。
examples.en: Whether he stays or goes is still undecided.

usage.en: Predicate or noun phrase, usually with 仍是/尚是. Formal.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或名词短语，常与“仍是”“尚是”连用，书面语。

natural: whether it knows or blames me

meaning.en: Let others, or history, judge whether I was right or wrong.
meaning.zh: 让别人或后世去评价我是对还是错，表示对自己所作所为问心无愧。

examples.zh: 他写下这部史书，知我罪我，任凭后人评说。
examples.en: He wrote this history and left it to later generations to praise or blame him.

examples.zh: 这件事我自认问心无愧，知我罪我，听其自然。
examples.en: I feel my conscience is clear in this matter; whether praised or blamed, so be it.

examples.zh: 改革成败，知我罪我，留待历史评判。
examples.en: Whether the reform succeeds or fails, let history judge me.

story.en: After Confucius compiled the Spring and Autumn Annals, Mencius says he reportedly remarked: 'Those who understand me will do so through the Annals; those who condemn me will do so through the Annals' (知我者其惟《春秋》乎！罪我者其惟《春秋》乎！).
story.zh: 《孟子·滕文公下》：“孔子惧，作《春秋》……孔子曰：‘知我者其惟《春秋》乎！罪我者其惟《春秋》乎！’”

usage.en: Used by a speaker about their own work or conduct; literary and slightly solemn.
usage.zh: 多用于说话人评价自己的作为，书面语，语气庄重。

natural: a father's debt is repaid by his son

meaning.en: A son is expected to repay his father's debts; traditional morality holds children to the family's obligations.
meaning.zh: 父亲欠下的债务，由儿子偿还。

equivalents: the sins of the father are visited on the son
the son pays the father's debts

examples.zh: 老人去世前反复叮嘱：父债子还，天经地义。
examples.en: Before he died the old man kept insisting that a son pays his father's debts, as a matter of course.

examples.zh: 在旧社会，父债子还是常有的事。
examples.en: In the old society, sons paying their fathers' debts was common.

examples.zh: 按现行法律，父债子还只限于继承的遗产范围。
examples.en: Under current law, a son's liability for a father's debt extends only as far as the estate he inherits.

usage.en: Independent saying, colloquial; today legally limited to inherited assets.
usage.zh: 多作独立语句，口语。现行法律中，子女仅在继承遗产范围内负责。

natural: a fire that burns the plain

meaning.en: A fire that sweeps across a whole prairie; a small force that spreads and becomes unstoppable.
meaning.zh: 能把原野烧遍的大火，比喻开始虽小，但发展迅速、势不可挡的力量。

equivalents: a movement that spreads like wildfire

examples.zh: 一场小小的抗议，竟成了燎原之火。
examples.en: A small protest grew into a prairie fire.

examples.zh: 他的几句话点燃了人们心中的燎原之火。
examples.en: His few words lit a fire in people's hearts that spread everywhere.

examples.zh: 这个小品牌在年轻人中形成燎原之火。
examples.en: This small brand spread like wildfire among young people.

usage.en: Noun phrase, used metaphorically; often with 点燃/形成. From the saying 星星之火，可以燎原.
usage.zh: 名词短语，多作比喻，常与“点燃”“形成”搭配。源自“星星之火，可以燎原”。

natural: pull and tug by force

meaning.en: To force a connection or drag someone along by force; to link unrelated things artificially.
meaning.zh: 硬拉硬拽；也指把没有关系的事物牵强地联系在一起。

examples.zh: 别生拉硬扯，两件事根本没有关系。
examples.en: Don't force a link; the two matters have nothing to do with each other.

examples.zh: 他生拉硬扯，非要我陪他去参加聚会。
examples.en: He kept dragging me along by force to go to the party with him.

examples.zh: 文章把不相干的材料生拉硬扯在一起，显得牵强。
examples.en: The article forces unrelated materials together and reads as contrived.

usage.en: Verb phrase or adverbial; colloquial, critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，口语，含贬义。

natural: to counterattack and reverse the settlement

meaning.en: To strike back and reclaim what was taken away, said of dispossessed groups; now also used of any attempt to reverse a settled outcome.
meaning.zh: 原指被打倒的剥削阶级向革命力量反扑，夺回已失去的利益；现也指推翻已定的结论，向对方报复性反扑。

equivalents: to hit back and reclaim lost ground

examples.zh: 土改后，一些地主企图反攻倒算，夺回土地。
examples.en: After land reform some landlords tried to strike back and take their land again.

examples.zh: 协议签了就是签了，不能事后反攻倒算。
examples.en: An agreement is an agreement; one cannot go back on it with a counterattack later.

examples.zh: 对于想反攻倒算的势力，要提高警惕。
examples.en: We must stay on guard against forces that want to hit back and reverse the outcome.

usage.en: Verb phrase; political register, strongly negative, associated with 1950s class-struggle language.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，政治语体，贬义强，带有二十世纪五十年代阶级斗争话语的色彩。

natural: matters, big or small

meaning.en: Whether the matter is big or small; without exception.
meaning.zh: 不管事情大还是小，一律如此。

examples.zh: 他事无大小，都亲自过问。
examples.en: He looks into everything himself, big or small.

examples.zh: 诸葛亮事无大小，必亲自处理。
examples.en: Zhuge Liang personally handled every matter, great and small.

examples.zh: 管家对府中事无大小，都了如指掌。
examples.en: The steward knows everything about the household, large or small.

usage.en: Adverbial, usually followed by 都/皆/必. Formal and slightly archaic. Very close to 事无巨细.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常与“都”“皆”“必”连用，书面语，略带文言色彩。与“事无巨细”意近。

natural: gather together in one hall

meaning.en: For many outstanding people or things to assemble in one place.
meaning.zh: 许多杰出的人物或精美的事物聚集在一个地方。

equivalents: bring together the best in one place

examples.zh: 各国专家荟萃一堂，共商发展大计。
examples.en: Experts from various countries gathered together to discuss development.

examples.zh: 这场展览让全国名画荟萃一堂。
examples.en: The exhibition brings the nation's famous paintings together.

examples.zh: 大会使各界精英荟萃一堂。
examples.en: The conference gathered elites from every field in one place.

usage.en: Predicate; formal, used for events and exhibitions. 荟萃 means to gather (of fine things).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，常用于会议、展览。“荟萃”指聚集。

natural: season the cauldrons

meaning.en: To balance flavours in the great cauldrons; to manage state affairs as a chief minister.
meaning.zh: 鼎鼐是古代烹饪用的大锅，调和鼎鼐原指烹调，比喻宰相治理国家大事。

equivalents: to steer the ship of state as chief minister

examples.zh: 他入阁拜相，调和鼎鼐，治国有方。
examples.en: He joined the cabinet as chief minister and ran affairs of state with skill.

examples.zh: 宰辅之职，在于调和鼎鼐，平衡各方。
examples.en: The task of a chief minister is to balance all sides like seasoning in the cauldron.

examples.zh: 这位首席执行官善于调和鼎鼐，协调各部门的意见。
examples.en: The CEO is good at harmonising the views of every department.

usage.en: Predicate; literary and used of statecraft. 鼎鼐 is read dǐng nài; 鼐 = large cauldron.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，用于治国理政。“鼐”指大鼎。

natural: only bright virtue is fragrant

meaning.en: Only good moral character gives off lasting fragrance; virtue alone earns lasting honour.
meaning.zh: 只有美好的品德才能散发出芳香，指德行才是最宝贵、最能感动人的。

equivalents: only virtue leaves a lasting fragrance

examples.zh: 校训取“明德惟馨”，勉励学生以德立身。
examples.en: The school motto is 'only bright virtue is fragrant', urging students to build their lives on virtue.

examples.zh: 黍稷非馨，明德惟馨，供品再丰厚也比不上善行。
examples.en: The finest offering cannot match good deeds, for only virtue is fragrant.

examples.zh: 明德惟馨，他一生清廉，受到乡亲的怀念。
examples.en: Virtue alone is fragrant, and his lifelong honesty is remembered by his neighbours.

story.en: The Book of Documents has the line 'Millet and sorghum are not fragrant; only bright virtue is fragrant' (黍稷非馨，明德惟馨), also quoted in the Zuo Commentary as a saying of the Zhou documents.
story.zh: 《尚书·君陈》：“至治馨香，感于神明。黍稷非馨，明德惟馨。”

usage.en: Often inscribed as a motto; formal. Comes from the line that millet and sorghum are not themselves fragrant: it is virtue that is.
usage.zh: 常用作校训、匾额，书面语。原文是说祭品本身不香，美德才香。

literal: guard against · small · think of · distant
natural: watch the small, plan for the distant

meaning.en: To nip small problems in the bud and look to the long term.
meaning.zh: 在小问题刚出现时就加以防范，并考虑长远的后果。

equivalents: nip problems in the bud and think ahead
take precautions and plan far ahead

examples.zh: 管理者必须防微虑远，把隐患消灭在萌芽中。
examples.en: A manager must nip small problems in the bud and think far ahead.

examples.zh: 防微虑远，才能保证企业长久经营。
examples.en: Only by guarding against small trouble and looking ahead can a firm last.

examples.zh: 他做事防微虑远，从不打无准备之仗。
examples.en: He works with an eye on small risks and the far future, and never fights without preparation.

usage.en: Predicate; formal. Close to 防微杜渐 and 深谋远虑.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。与“防微杜渐”“深谋远虑”意近。

natural: founding an enterprise is hard

meaning.en: Starting an enterprise or a state is hard; one should cherish what has been built.
meaning.zh: 开创事业十分艰难，应当珍惜既成的基业。

equivalents: getting a business off the ground is tough

examples.zh: 创业维艰，守成亦不易，希望大家珍惜今天的成果。
examples.en: Founding is hard and keeping is no easier, so please cherish today's results.

examples.zh: 他深知创业维艰，所以对每一分钱都精打细算。
examples.en: He knows how hard it is to start a business and counts every penny.

examples.zh: 创业维艰，许多初创公司第一年就倒闭了。
examples.en: Starting up is hard, and many start-ups close in their first year.

usage.en: Predicate or stand-alone remark; formal. Usually followed by 守成不易.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或独立语句，书面语，常与“守成不易”连用。

natural: play dumb and act blank

meaning.en: To pretend not to know or understand, in order to avoid a matter.
meaning.zh: 故意装作不懂、不知道的样子，以逃避责任或应付别人。

examples.zh: 问他钱的事，他就装傻充愣。
examples.en: Ask him about the money and he plays dumb.

examples.zh: 你别在我面前装傻充愣，我心里都明白。
examples.en: Don't play dumb with me; I understand it all.

examples.zh: 同事在会上装傻充愣，把问题推给了别人。
examples.en: The colleague played dumb at the meeting and passed the problem to others.

usage.en: Predicate; colloquial, mildly critical. 愣 is lèng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语，略含贬义。“愣”读lèng。

natural: kind heart and kind skill

meaning.en: A caring heart together with excellent professional skill, of a doctor.
meaning.zh: 既有仁爱之心，又有高明的医术。

equivalents: a heart and hands that heal

examples.zh: 张医生仁心仁术，深受患者爱戴。
examples.en: Dr Zhang is a healer in heart and hands, much loved by patients.

examples.zh: 医者当仁心仁术，既要有技术，也要有温度。
examples.en: A doctor should have compassion and skill: technique, and warmth.

examples.zh: 医院授予她“仁心仁术”的锦旗。
examples.en: The hospital presented her with a banner reading 'Kind heart, kind skill'.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate, mostly in praise of doctors; formal, often seen on thank-you banners.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，多用于称赞医生，常见于锦旗。

text: 三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮
pinyin: sān gè chòu pí jiàng, sài guò zhū gě liàng
literal: three · stinking · cobblers · surpass · Zhuge Liang
natural: three humble cobblers beat Zhuge Liang

meaning.en: Pooling the wisdom of ordinary people can beat the cleverest individual.
meaning.zh: 几个普通人集思广益，也能胜过一个才智超群的人。

equivalents: two heads are better than one

examples.zh: 三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮，大家一起讨论，办法就有了。
examples.en: Three cobblers beat a Zhuge Liang; talk it through together and a solution will appear.

examples.zh: 项目遇到难题时，他总说三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮。
examples.en: When the project hit trouble he would say three humble heads outdo one genius.

examples.zh: 别觉得自己人微言轻，三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮。
examples.en: Don't think you are too humble to matter; three cobblers beat a Zhuge Liang.

usage.en: Independent saying; encouraging, often said at brainstorming. 诸葛亮 here stands for supreme wisdom.
usage.zh: 多作独立语句，常用于鼓励集体讨论。“诸葛亮”代表高超的智慧。

text: 良言一句三冬暖，恶语伤人六月寒
pinyin: liáng yán yī jù sān dōng nuǎn, è yǔ shāng rén liù yuè hán
literal: good · words · one · sentence · three winter months · warm, harsh · words · hurt · people · sixth month · cold
natural: one kind word warms three winter months; a cruel one chills even June

meaning.en: A kind remark can warm a person through the winter, while cruel words chill them even in midsummer.
meaning.zh: 一句好话能让人在严冬里感到温暖，一句恶语却能让人在盛夏里觉得寒冷，说明言语影响很大。

equivalents: a kind word goes a long way

examples.zh: 良言一句三冬暖，恶语伤人六月寒，说话要注意分寸。
examples.en: One kind word warms three winters and a cruel one chills in June, so watch what you say.

examples.zh: 老师总说良言一句三冬暖，恶语伤人六月寒，要多鼓励同学。
examples.en: The teacher always said that a kind word warms and a cruel one chills, so encourage your classmates.

examples.zh: 良言一句三冬暖，恶语伤人六月寒，何必出口伤人呢？
examples.en: A kind word warms the winter and harsh words chill the summer, so why hurt people?

usage.en: Independent saying, used to advise on speech; commonly quoted in two halves.
usage.zh: 多作独立语句，劝人说话要有分寸，常分前后两半引用。

pinyin: tài suì tóu shàng dòng tǔ
literal: Grand Duke Jupiter · on the head · break · ground
natural: break ground on the head of the Jupiter god

meaning.en: To offend someone powerful and dangerous; to court trouble.
meaning.zh: 在太岁的头上动土，比喻触犯有权势、惹不起的人，自找麻烦。

equivalents: beard the lion in his den

examples.zh: 你敢到他头上动手，这不是太岁头上动土吗？
examples.en: You'd dare lay a hand on him? That is courting disaster.

examples.zh: 新来的职员居然在太岁头上动土，批评了老板的方案。
examples.en: The new employee dared to take on the boss and criticised his plan.

examples.zh: 别在太岁头上动土，他可不是好惹的。
examples.en: Don't mess with him; he isn't someone to cross.

usage.en: Verb phrase, often as a rhetorical question or a warning. In folk belief, the Grand Duke Jupiter (太岁) is an unlucky star spirit whose direction one must not dig or build facing.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常用反问或警告。民间认为太岁是凶神，其方位不可动土。

natural: relics old and young

meaning.en: Loyalists of a fallen dynasty, old and young; today also people stuck in outdated ideas.
meaning.zh: 指改朝换代后仍忠于旧朝的人；今也指思想守旧、跟不上时代的人。

equivalents: die-hard relics of the old order

examples.zh: 民国初年，北京城里还有不少遗老遗少。
examples.en: In the early Republic, Beijing still had plenty of Qing loyalists, old and young.

examples.zh: 他满脑子旧思想，活像个遗老遗少。
examples.en: His head is full of old ideas; he is a real relic of a bygone age.

examples.zh: 别把顽固守旧的人都当成遗老遗少。
examples.en: Don't treat everyone who clings to the old ways as a relic.

usage.en: Noun; negative, sometimes mocking.
usage.zh: 名词，含贬义，有时带嘲讽。

pinyin: dōng fēng yā dǎo xī fēng
natural: the east wind prevails over the west wind

meaning.en: Said that the forces of progress overcome the forces of reaction.
meaning.zh: 比喻新生进步的力量压倒腐朽反动的力量。

equivalents: the tide turns in our favour

examples.zh: 在那场辩论中，他们东风压倒西风，一举扭转了局势。
examples.en: In the debate, they overpowered the other side and turned the situation around.

examples.zh: 她用事实说话，东风压倒西风，会议很快一致通过。
examples.en: She let the facts speak, the east wind overcame the west, and the meeting quickly agreed.

examples.zh: 两队对峙多年，今年终于东风压倒西风。
examples.en: After years of standoff the east wind has finally overcome the west.

origin.source: 毛泽东1957年在莫斯科的讲话

story.en: At the 1957 Moscow meeting of communist parties Mao said, 'There are two winds in the world, the east wind and the west wind. As a Chinese saying has it, either the east wind prevails over the west wind or the west wind over the east,' echoing a remark by Lin Daiyu in Dream of the Red Chamber.
story.zh: 1957年毛泽东在莫斯科会议上说：“世界上现在有两种风，东风和西风……我认为目前形势的特点是东风压倒西风。”此语借自《红楼梦》林黛玉的话。

usage.en: Slogan-like; political and formal; also used jokingly in contests. Mao quoted the line from Dream of the Red Chamber when speaking about world affairs.
usage.zh: 带标语色彩，政治语体，也可用于比赛。毛泽东曾引《红楼梦》此语论述国际形势。

natural: blow off the husk and see the rice

meaning.en: To see results right away; getting a quick return.
meaning.zh: 吹去谷皮，立即见到米，比喻做事立刻见效。

examples.zh: 这项政策吹糠见米，一个月就见成效。
examples.en: The policy gave quick results, working within a month.

examples.zh: 做生意没有吹糠见米的事，要有耐心。
examples.en: Business never gives instant returns; one must be patient.

examples.zh: 他只想要吹糠见米的好处，不愿长期投入。
examples.en: He wants only instant payoffs and will not invest for the long term.

usage.en: Adjectival or predicate. Commonly used as a modifier ('吹糠见米的效果'), or negatively to say something takes time.
usage.zh: 多作定语或谓语，常说“吹糠见米的效果”，也常用否定式。

natural: treat as a breeze by one's ear

meaning.en: To take no notice of what is said; to ignore advice.
meaning.zh: 把别人的话当作耳边吹过的风，毫不在意。

equivalents: go in one ear and out the other

examples.zh: 我的劝告他全当耳边风。
examples.en: He ignored all my advice.

examples.zh: 老师的话，他从来都当耳边风。
examples.en: He always brushes off the teacher's words.

examples.zh: 别把安全规定当耳边风，出了事谁负责？
examples.en: Don't take the safety rules as idle wind; who will answer if something goes wrong?

usage.en: Verb phrase, often split as 把……当耳边风. Also written 当耳旁风.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常拆开用作“把……当耳边风”。也写作“当耳旁风”。

pinyin: fēng zhà qǐ, chuī zhòu yī chí chūn shuǐ
literal: wind · suddenly · rises, blow · wrinkle · one · pond · spring · water
natural: when the wind suddenly rises it ripples the pond of spring water

meaning.en: A sudden breeze ruffles still water; used for a small disturbance that stirs a calm heart or situation.
meaning.zh: 风忽然吹起，使一池春水泛起涟漪，比喻某个小小的变动搅动了平静的心情或局面。

equivalents: a small ripple on a calm pond
a sudden stir in a quiet heart

examples.zh: 风乍起，吹皱一池春水，她的心也跟着泛起了涟漪。
examples.en: A wind rose and wrinkled the spring pond, and her heart too began to ripple.

examples.zh: 风乍起，吹皱一池春水，小小的消息搅乱了平静的日子。
examples.en: A sudden wind wrinkles a pond of spring water, and this small piece of news upset the quiet days.

examples.zh: 他常用“风乍起，吹皱一池春水”来形容少女的心事。
examples.en: He often uses 'the wind rises and wrinkles a pond of spring water' to describe a young girl's stirrings.

story.en: The Southern Tang poet Feng Yansi begins his lyric: 'The wind suddenly rises and wrinkles a pond of spring water' (风乍起，吹皱一池春水).
story.zh: 五代·冯延巳《谒金门》：“风乍起，吹皱一池春水。闲引鸳鸯香径里，手挼红杏蕊。”

usage.en: Independent line, literary, often quoted for sudden emotion. The second half (吹皱一池春水) is also used on its own.
usage.zh: 多作独立诗句，书面语，常用来形容情绪的突然波动。后半句“吹皱一池春水”也可单独使用。

natural: enough to make one spit out one's food

meaning.en: So funny that it makes one burst out laughing.
meaning.zh: 太可笑了，使人忍不住笑得把嘴里的饭喷出来。

examples.zh: 他那番自作聪明的解释，实在令人喷饭。
examples.en: His self-satisfied explanation was just hilarious.

examples.zh: 这篇小品的结尾令人喷饭。
examples.en: The sketch's ending is enough to make you spit out your food.

examples.zh: 网上有个视频，内容令人喷饭。
examples.en: There is a video online whose content is a scream.

usage.en: Predicate; colloquial. May mean either good-humoured fun or mocking ridicule.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语。可指有趣，也可带讥笑意味。
